integrity: Finite differences and angular covariance identities are proved explicitly; a standalone numerical verifier provides 1450 supplementary tests. The originality comparison uses accessible primary texts and mathematical-record searches; publication-priority completeness and independent scientific audit are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exact-arithmetic full-length one-direction forward-finite-difference subspace Newton on positive diagonal planar quadratics, i.i.d. uniform-circle or uniformly signed coordinate sketches, fixed positive radius, no safeguard. Does not extend to arbitrary dimensions, noisy oracles, centered differences, line searches or nonquadratic objectives.
title: Exact stationary error floors for one-direction finite-difference Newton sketches
